description: A template for collecting file-level metadata for scRNA-seq fastq files (i.e., level 1 data).

assay.description: The technology used to generate the data.
assay.title: assay

assay_metadata_synID.description: The synID scRNA-seq assay metadata file corresponding to this data file.
assay_metadata_synID.title: assay_metadata_synID

biospecimen_metadata_synID.description: The synID biospecimen metadata file containing information about the samples profiled
biospecimen_metadata_synID.title: biospecimen_metadata_synID

data_level.description: The processing level of the data.
data_level.title: data_level

data_type.description: High-level classification of the type of data contained in the file, loosely related to the experimental method or biological entity that is being profiled.
data_type.title: data_type

file_format.description: Defined format of the data file, typically corresponding to extension, but sometimes indicating more general group of files produced by the same tool or software
file_format.title: file_format

resource_type.description: The type of resource being stored and annotated
resource_type.title: resource_type

specimen_modality.description: Label assigned to experimental data files indicating whether the data contained corresponds to a single or multiple biospecimens
specimen_modality.title: specimen_modality

title: ScRNASeqLevel1FileAnnotationsTemplate
